item.title: Nearly every state funds hands-on job training in high schools. Why not Wisconsin?
item.description: Whether students have access to career and technical education courses largely depends on if their school district can pay for them. That’s because Wisconsin is one of just five states that don’t dedicate state funding to these programs in public schools. Nearly every state funds hands-on job training in high schools.
